subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Hexachloroiridate(IV)（[IrCl₆]²⁻）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Tetrahedral
D. Trigonal planar
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Ir (group 9) 9 e; 6 × Cl (X) 6 e; the 2− charge adds 2 e: 17 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −6 in all and the complex has a 2− charge, so the metal is Ir(IV), d⁵; d⁵ + 12 e from the ligands = 17 e.
